summary: Bump the Foundry module manifest to 0.3.10 so the enhanced persisted canvas diagnostics are published through the existing release workflow.

checks.name: Manifest parses and reports 0.3.10
checks.run: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); if(m.version!=='0.3.10') throw new Error('manifest version mismatch');"
